name: contact-link-identity
description: Add a channel identity (email, phone, Signal, SMS, Telegram, Slack) to an existing contact. Refuses an address another contact has, and lists contacts with a similar one: retry with distinct_from if the address is right. Copy the address exactly from the message, page or email it came from; a number this contact already has verified on another phone-type channel needs no source. Re-stating an unverified address already on this contact verifies it, after the same checks, when it came from an earlier first-time send, or when the principal is asking for it now in a live conversation; otherwise only the principal can verify it. It cannot change the principal's own addresses. To update profile attributes (title, organization, timezone, etc.), use contact-update instead.

inputs.label: string?
inputs.distinct_from: string[]? (IDs from a refusal that you checked are different people)

outputs.derived_from: string? (the channel the number was already verified on)
